_note: 1_09 'The Candidate' — defend Earnest's speech in the auditorium while jock waves interrupt (recon: docs/re-notes/ch1/1_09-the-candidate.md). The defense is real: Earnest is a mission defender (player-team combat pawn, 100 hp, KO fails the stage), and every other wave member takes him as PreferredVictim. The speech plays as speech_sequence parts latched alongside each wave (both must finish). v1 simplifications (see the recon's gap table): the baked 1-09 cutscene is a title card + speech beat; the 26-entry timed attacker schedule compresses to three waves (jocks + mascot beat); the 30-line speech with hit interruptions compresses to three parts without the interrupt-resume; the seated crowd/jeers and the speaker-breakables fail are skipped; the camera-path intro sweep is one fixed shot; the player keeps his whole arsenal (the original locks him to the 306 with 1 unit — v1 grants the slingshot + ammo instead). On entry the clock sets to 18:45 and pauses, like the original's A2. Pass grants (306 -> slingshot, nerds 70 / jocks 45, clock paused into Halloween) live in the campaign table's on_pass for 1_09. Wording is original; ped_model_id records the original model ids next to the stand-in meshes.
title: The Candidate

stages.objective: Earnest is giving a speech. It will not go quietly.

lines.speaker: EARNEST
lines.text: They'll tear me apart up there, Jimmy. Keep them off me and I'll owe you everything.

stages.objective: Protect Earnest — the first wave is coming.

lines.speaker: EARNEST
lines.text: Fellow students! A vote for me is a vote for—

lines.speaker: EARNEST
lines.text: —for not getting your head dunked in a toilet, for a start!

stages.fail_text: Earnest was driven off the stage.

stages.objective: More of them. Keep the stage clear.

lines.speaker: EARNEST
lines.text: Is that the best they've got? As I was saying—

lines.speaker: EARNEST
lines.text: —a library budget! Real books! With pages!

stages.fail_text: Earnest was driven off the stage.

lines.speaker: EARNEST
lines.text: The mascot?! They're throwing EVERYTHING at me!

stages.fail_text: Earnest was driven off the stage.

lines.speaker: EARNEST
lines.text: Thank you! The nerds owe you everything — and I never forget a debt.

on_complete.text: campaign on_pass for 1_09: super slingshot 306 (mapped to slingshot), respect nerds 70 / jocks 45, clock paused into the Halloween night
